2. Import data from a database management system(DBMS)

## Install.packages("RMariaDB") # Installation of the DB Package

```{r}
library(DBI) #Provides common database functions
library(RMariaDB) # this help to transfer data from  database into R for data science.
library(rstudioapi) #Interacts with the RStudio application, including password prompts
con <- dbConnect(
  RMariaDB::MariaDB(),
  host = "127.0.0.1",
  port = 3306,
  username = "root",
  password = "",
  dbname = "universitystudentdb"
)
```

# Displaying data form database

```{r}

students_List<- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT * FROM student"
)

View(students_List)
```

## 3. : Import from an Internet URL

library(jsonlite)

## Here we have json file from a URL

```{r}
sales.data <- fromJSON("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kundan-Rwanda/sample-sales-data/refs/heads/main/sales.json",
  flatten = TRUE)

head(sales.data, 8)
```
